codex.label: OpenAI Codex
codex.purpose: Agent capable of interpreting the portable skills
setup: Sign in through the app or CLI
Install skills in your agent's supported directory
permissions: Sign in to your own AI provider account

feishu.label: Feishu / Lark
feishu.purpose: Company messaging, tasks, calendar and documents in their native application
setup: Sign in to the intended organization
Connect official API/CLI only where available
permissions: Approve requested Feishu user OAuth scopes
Request organization resource access if needed

apple_calendar.label: Apple Calendar
apple_calendar.purpose: Native calendar is the schedule source of truth
setup: Open system Calendar and verify the intended calendar account
permissions: Calendar access is approved interactively for the selected tool

apple_reminders.label: Apple Reminders
setup: Connect iCloud if desired
Install or use a trusted Reminders CLI only if needed

shortcuts.label: Apple Shortcuts
shortcuts.purpose: iPhone/Mac quick capture and user-initiated actions
setup: Review each automation before running it

dayflow.label: Dayflow
dayflow.purpose: Optional macOS activity journal; agent reads summaries via vendor CLI/MCP
setup: Review capture exclusions and model processor
Verify official CLI/MCP compatibility with the installed release
permissions: Grant Screen Recording only after understanding captured content
Review cloud AI and audio-processing choices

hermes.label: Hermes Agent
hermes.purpose: Optional agent gateway, memory and scheduling; connect rather than duplicate
setup: Select an existing local or remote instance
Verify authentic endpoint identity and ownership
Do not start a duplicate scheduler
permissions: Approve gateway token/OAuth via a supported secret manager

homebox.label: HomeBox
homebox.purpose: Dedicated native web UI for home items, receipts, locations and maintenance
setup: Connect a self-hosted or trusted existing HomeBox instance
Use its native UI for item details; link from any overview
permissions: Approve login to your own HomeBox service

nocobase.label: NocoBase
nocobase.purpose: Optional structured cross-source dashboard; not a replacement for native tools
setup: Reuse an existing authorized NocoBase instance if present
Use native mobile layout and built-in MCP with scoped API key
permissions: Grant read-only access first; independently verify any writes

obsidian.label: Obsidian
obsidian.purpose: Personal note vault, keeps its native editor and data ownership
setup: Open existing vault through your chosen sync method
permissions: Grant access to selected vaults, not the entire home directory

lark_cli.label: Lark CLI (Feishu OpenAPI)
lark_cli.purpose: Direct Feishu tasks, calendar, message and document access using existing bot/user OAuth; no Hermes needed
setup: Reuse your trusted organization lark-cli distribution (do not install an unverified namesake)
Sign in through lark-cli native user OAuth when necessary
Verify user vs bot identity for each command, request missing resource scopes
permissions: OAuth and organization ACL apply to the CLI identity, not to Hermes
Company-owned records remain in company-approved systems
